# Imported Runnable option contracts

The following files are copied byte for byte from codefly-dev/core v0.17.0.
They are import-only; Core registers their Go descriptors. Generate only the
owned `saas` tree with `--path saas`. The existing `codefly/api.proto` client
facade stays excluded.

- `codefly/base/v0/agent.proto`
- `codefly/base/v0/endpoint.proto`
- `codefly/base/v0/library.proto`
- `codefly/base/v0/network.proto`
- `codefly/base/v0/readiness.proto`
- `codefly/base/v0/runnable.proto`
- `codefly/base/v0/scope.proto`
- `codefly/base/v0/work_context.proto`
- `codefly/runnable/v0/options.proto`
